analysis_md:
由点 $(3,-2,1)$ 在曲面 $F(x+y+z,xyz)=0$ 上，则 $F(2,-6)=0$，曲面在点 $(3,-2,1)$ 处的偏导数为：

$$\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial F}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=4\cdot1+2\cdot(-2)\cdot1=0，\quad \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial F}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=10，\quad \frac{\partial F}{\partial z}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial F}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}=-8，$$

则曲面的切平面为：$10(y+2)-8(z-1)=0$，即：$5y-4z+14=0$。
